name: Oxford Nanopore
devices: Flongle, MinION, GridION, PromethION (P2 Solo, P24, P48)
reads: Tens of kb typical; ultra-long >100 kb possible
accuracy: ~Q20+ simplex with SUP models; higher for duplex
role: Our main platform: long-read MAGs, circular genomes, plasmids, methylation-aware binning. Watch for untrimmed adapters, barcodes and chimeras left after basecalling.

name: PacBio HiFi
role: High-accuracy long-read metagenomes and full-length amplicons (Kinnex 16S). Residual adapters and concatemers need filtering.

name: Illumina
role: Deep, cheap coverage for profiling, strain variation and polishing.

name: Element AVITI
role: Short-read alternative with high base quality; same downstream tools.

name: MGI / Complete Genomics
role: Low-cost short reads. CycloneSEQ availability in Europe is constrained by ONT patent litigation.

name: Ultima Genomics
accuracy: High per-base, homopolymer indels are the main error
role: Very low cost per Gb for deep profiling; check homopolymer handling.

name: Roche SBX
chem: Sequencing by expansion (Xpandomers read on a CMOS nanopore array)
role: New 2026 high-throughput entrant; tool compatibility still settling.
